articles.title: ABSA increases risk financing despite soft insurance market
articles.summary: ABSA increased retained-risk financing at its November 1 renewal despite soft pricing, keeping predictable losses in its Isle of Man captive, a total-cost-of-risk lesson for Canadian buyers enjoying lower rates.

articles.title: AM Best Report Outlines Rating Considerations for Captive Insurers
articles.summary: AM Best's new FAQ explains how it rates captives and cell companies, applying a weakest-link test to unincorporated cells and generally capping captive business profile assessments at Neutral.

articles.title: Captive domiciles offer competing advantages as companies weigh their options
articles.summary: With 77 captive domiciles worldwide, panellists urged owners to weigh tax, capital, regulation and exit flexibility, and to revisit domicile choice annually, including moving a captive when circumstances change.

articles.title: BMA licences one new captive in October
articles.summary: Bermuda licensed one captive-class insurer in October, Class A long-term captive Project Pearl ISAC Ltd, bringing 2026 captive-class formations to eight through the first 10 months.

articles.title: Guidance Note – General business insurers with segregated accounts and separate accounts
articles.summary: Bermuda's new BMA guidance, effective January 1, 2027, requires each cell to meet its own solvency, liquidity and collateral tests, adding governance and reporting duties for Canadian parents using Bermuda cell captives.

articles.title: Why some Canadian companies are bringing captive risks home to Alberta
articles.summary: Hub International says Canadian firms are redomiciling captive risks from offshore to Alberta, citing flexible rules now allowing surety, lower premiums, and better tax outcomes than offshore captives taxed under FAPI.
